title: Effects of Financial Constraints on Supply Chain Financing Choices and Operational Decisions
eligible_reason: Binary IBBEA deregulation indicator switching on at state-specific dates (5 adoption cohorts: 1995, 1996, 1997, 1999, 2001); Table 4 Column 1 is a static TWFE regression of log inventory turnover on IBBEA with firm (st_unit) and group-by-year (st_year) fixed effects, no controls, clustered by state.
design_notes: Treatment IBBEA = 1 if fiscal year > year(plcyDate), where plcyDate is the effective date of the firm's state's interstate bank branching deregulation (IBBEA). Verified in main_df: IBBEA==0 for all year-plcyYear<=0 and IBBEA==1 for all year-plcyYear>=1. Panel of firms 1990-2005 (16 years). Every firm has a plcyDate (no never-treated units); the comparison group is not-yet-treated firms; all units are treated from 2002 onward. st_unit is a firm identifier (722 units, one row per st_unit-year, one plcyDate per st_unit). st_year is NOT a stacked-cohort time index: it has 150 values that partition into 11 connected blocks of st_units, each block spanning 8-16 calendar years with one st_year value per year, so st_year = block x calendar year (block is a time-invariant firm grouping, most likely industry; the data contain no explicit block variable but it can be recovered as the connected components of the st_unit-st_year bipartite graph). This is allowed (time-invariant characteristic x calendar-time FE). Tables 2, 3 and Table 4 Columns 2-4 and Table 5 add time-varying firm controls (size, gm, wacc, log(surprise+1), trade_credit, cash_flow), the additional treatment indicator treat_customer, i_exp subgroup interactions, or IPW weights, and are therefore ineligible. Figure 1 (main text) is an event study with the same time-varying controls (ineligible). Appendix E reports Callaway-Sant'Anna (att_gt, not-yet-treated controls, unconditional, idname=unit, gname=plcyYear) on the unstacked full_df, a Goodman-Bacon decomposition, and a Cengiz-style weighted stacked event study, all in the appendix. Appendix E also runs felm(log(IT+1) ~ IBBEA | unit + year, cluster state) on full_df as the reference line of the placebo histogram (Figure E2).
estimators_reported: stacked DiD with Wing et al. weights (Appendix E, Table E4)

specs.code: t4_1 <- feols(log(IT + 1) ~ IBBEA | st_unit + st_year, data = main_df, cluster = "state")
specs.outcome_description: log of inventory turnover plus one
specs.treatment_definition: 1 if year > year(plcyDate); plcyDate = state's interstate branching deregulation effective date (firm-level panel, state-level assignment)
specs.fe: st_unit + st_year (st_year = block x year, 11 blocks; block is time-invariant within st_unit)
specs.notes: Column 1 of Table 4 is the no-controls baseline; Column 2 adds treat_customer and controls. Standard errors clustered by state (44 states).

ineligible_main_text_specs.reason: time-varying firm controls; Columns 3 and 5 add IBBEA x i_exp subgroup interactions
time-varying controls; Columns 2-3 and 5-6 add i_exp interactions and IPW weights
additional treatment indicator treat_customer, time-varying controls, i_exp interactions, IPW
short/long x i_exp interactions with time-varying controls and mediators
event study with time-varying controls and treat_customer

preferred_spec_note: Table 4 Column 1 is the baseline; the authors' preferred inventory-turnover estimate is likely Column 2 (with controls), which is ineligible. The abstract's 6% figure matches the 0.061 coefficient in both columns.
data_files: 7_Data_and_Code_Files/data/appendix_extra_data.RData (full_df 8634x12 with unit, year, plcyDate, state, IT, IBBEA, controls)
software_detail: R >= 4.2, fixest::feols (main tables), lfe::felm and did::att_gt (appendix)
screener_notes: No article text available; screened from code, README and abstract. For CSA/BJS re-estimation: idname = st_unit, tname = year, gname = year(plcyDate) + 1, control group = not-yet-treated (no never-treated), cluster = state, outcome log(IT+1), and include the block x year FE (recover block from st_year). The 2001 cohort has a single firm. Alternatively full_df (appendix_extra_data.RData) gives an unstacked firm panel with plain unit + year FE used in Appendix E, but the main-text spec uses main_df with st_unit + st_year.
